contract.governing_equations: alpha=epsilon0 M; V Tr(M^-1)<=1 (imported); Tr(alpha)>=9epsilon0 V; R=Tr(alpha)/m; phi<=1-K/R_U. Fixed affine-field F=qe+Gp; four-sign projection extracts G alpha e.
assumptions: Bounded connected C^{1,beta} filled conductor; electrically shielded closed cavities only; positive static polarizability tensor.
For each admitted particle: valid density/nonmetal-mass/physical-to-PEC trace bounds, not bulk-average estimates.
Ideal projection fixes position, orientation, charge and free-space affine-field environment across signs; real residuals require a new bound.
contract.conservation_and_thermodynamics: Electrostatic self-force cancels; G is symmetric trace-free in source-free vacuum. The signed data projection is not a net passive-force or free-energy gain. All preparation/control/recovery costs remain charged.
contract.materials: Nominal Al rho=2700 kg/m^3 is an assumption; oxide/coating, nonmetal mass, alloy density and finite-frequency response must be bounded per particle.
contract.units_and_tolerances: SI alpha and particle mass; R in polarizability/kg; void fraction dimensionless. Nominal 30 micrometre diameter, E=1e6 V/m and g=1e9 V/m^2 are design inputs. 0.2% repeatability is not coverage; the source illustrates a stricter ~0.046% random target under specific material/risk assumptions.
contract.input_acquisition: Acquire a true upper bound on trace/mass, actual trajectory/rotation, charge and field waveform/geometry; independently acquire material premises and reference void ground truth. No instrument or tomography interface is free.
contract.error_budget: Signed measurement phases, electrical versus mass/optical center, finite electrodes/images/higher harmonics, coating dynamics, gas drag, neighbors, calibration drift and systematic negative bias must be bounded on admitted particles.
contract.energy_balance: UNKNOWN measured energy per accepted kg. Charge pumping, field drives, illumination/readout, tracking, feeding, actuation, recovery and cleaning; the unipolar displacement calculator is not the signed instrument energy budget.
contract.reliability: Freeze one-sided response coverage and admission rules. Illustrative hour-wide 1% risk uses a union bound and assumed calibrated Gaussian tails; no industrial tail guarantee or independence follows from a small trial.
contract.resources: First one-particle blinded apparatus and independent bounded ground truth, cost UNKNOWN. Later neighbor/actuator tests, then a 500–1000 particle/s lane; 1 kg/h needs ~7.28 million nominal particles/s.

experiments.prediction: Within explicitly admitted premises, a covered upper R bound predicts closed-void fraction <= the declared cutoff; the same trace must be recovered across admitted orientation/charge/spin/field sweeps.
experiments.equipment_or_data: Calibrated harmonic/sign-controlled electrodes, two-view trajectory/charge/spin measurements and independently bounded tomography or destructive-section ground truth. Nominal 30 micrometre cavity standards must be fabricated/validated, not presumed available.
experiments.controls: Dense and nominal 1%,2%,5% closed-void references; off-center cavities, shape variations, charge/spin/orientation sweeps; isolated particles. Keep calibration separate from held-out blind trials.
experiments.expected_signal: Source assumed sphere force scale is 9.84 m/s^2; that unipolar signal is not the signed transfer function. Actual trace/error mapping must be measured; a 1% cavity is a target distinction, not an observed effect.
experiments.uncertainty: Predeclare total one-sided bound including material, systematic negative bias, motion/rotation, optical COM, electrode residuals and statistical coverage. Repeatability alone does not establish this bound.
experiments.estimated_cost: UNKNOWN; apparatus, reference fabrication, independent ground truth, operators and calibration not costed. No funding or external contact authorized by this record.
experiments.invalidates: A held-out admitted particle accepted above the void threshold beyond declared coverage, unbounded negative bias, unrecovered trace across admitted conditions or negligible dense-particle yield rejects or restricts the proposed acquisition capability.
experiments.procedure: Source protocol: fixed-body signed trace first; freeze estimator/admission/calibration/bias budget before blinded free-particle trials, independently ground-truth each indexed particle; preserve every failure and raw trajectory. Do not proceed to industrial claims from a small successful test.
experiments.acceptance: Demonstrate conservative error coverage and useful dense-particle yield in the frozen domain with independent ground truth; state finite sample limits. This gate remains unexecuted.
